acceptance_criteria: A fresh executor starts from PADataset README.md at the pinned resume-framework checkpoint and routes only into the resume/application domain.
Candidate/application truth, private values, target-specific evidence, production specs, and submission semantics remain domain-owned rather than copied into workspace-control.
The shared document-artifact lifecycle maps cleanly to source -> deterministic build/render -> structural/static validation -> visual QA -> bounded revision -> delivery gate.
Automated visual QA is accepted when sufficient; a human gate is retained only where the resume/application owner explicitly requires substantive judgment.
The task explicitly evaluates PADataset-vs-dedicated-private-domain ownership before any repository move; no move is automatic.
PADataset research/framework content outside resumes/** is not mutated by this integration.
Any eventual repository move, if justified, is separately authorized and leaves a durable provenance/redirect plan.
The final integration checkpoint is pushed/verified and recoverable without prior conversation.
constraints: Do not mutate workspace-control shared architecture from this child.
Do not mutate PADataset research, RF dataset, paper, slide, or unrelated application domains outside the authorized resume paths.
Do not create a new repository or move private data merely because separation is conceptually cleaner; require a justified migration decision and explicit authority.
Do not expose private candidate/application values into workspace-control or public artifacts.
Do not submit applications, send messages, or perform external irreversible actions as part of architecture integration.
If resume-framework moves from the pinned checkpoint, refresh this capsule before mutation.
